tools.name: Timeline Planner
tools.description: Enter start and end dates for each SDLC activity and get a slide-ready Gantt timeline with swimlanes, holidays, milestones and status colors.

tools.name: Activity Tracker
tools.description: Track every project activity by phase, with status, percent complete, dates and owner. See what is overdue, due soon or missing dates at a glance.

tools.name: Develop Team - Individual KPIs
tools.description: Track your own KPIs against Min, Standard and Stretch targets. Log each achievement and attach evidence files, links or screenshots.

tools.name: Risk Register & Heat Map
tools.description: Rate risks on a 5x5 heat map with drag and drop, get a recommended response plan for common banking project risks, and download a PDF risk report.

tools.name: Work Breakdown Structure
tools.description: Break a project into deliverables and work packages with automatic numbering, effort roll-up and a tree chart. Send work packages straight to the Timeline.
